limitations: the CoT schema edition this adapter is written against is NOT STATED by any document in this repository — `fixtures/tak/spec/tak_terms.json` records the Base-Event Schema's own version as its publisher states it, which is a reading of that page and not a statement that this implementation targets it, so `format.version` is null rather than guessed
contact atoms only on ingest; CoT types outside `a-.-...` are out of scope

leftovers are parked in `Entity.attributes` / `Event.payload` under `source_extras` (`lossless.residual()`), not in the origin-identifying container ARCHITECTURE.md §5 gives to P3 — the Part 1 stance that section rules for the adapters already shipped
